prompt.en: A dipole wire runs northeast-southwest in free space. Where is radiation strongest?

text.en: Equally nowhere because a dipole does not radiate
Broadside to the wire, northwest and southeast

explanation.en: A free-space half-wave dipole has maximum radiation broadside to the wire and nulls off the ends.

prompt.en: A full-wave loop is estimated with 306 / f(MHz). About how much wire is needed at 12 MHz?

explanation.en: 306 divided by 12 is 25.5, so the loop starts near 25.5 metres total wire.

prompt.en: What is a likely station symptom when a poorly matched random-wire antenna brings RF back into the operating area?

text.en: The antenna becomes an isotropic point source
The feedline changes into open-wire line
RF feedback, such as distorted transmitted audio
The resonant frequency is guaranteed to stay fixed

explanation.en: Uncontrolled RF return paths can put RF current into station equipment and cause feedback symptoms.
